KIND: factual

WHERE: Scope and Design
EVIDENCE: docs/specs/exporter.md:16 introduces “a new container image that deploys on its own”; neither Scope nor Design names the satellite repository that publishes it. This fails the declared satellite lens.
PROPOSAL: Name the satellite repository responsible for publishing the image. If the repository has not been chosen, raise that decision in Open Questions.

FINDING: F-02
KIND: factual
SEVERITY: blocking
WHERE: Acceptance Criteria and Test Plan
EVIDENCE: docs/specs/exporter.md:16 promises widget metrics, but AC-01 at line 28 and its proof at line 34 check only image construction and the --health response. An image that exports no metrics can satisfy every criterion.
PROPOSAL: Define the widget metrics and how consumers retrieve them. Add an acceptance criterion and corresponding proof that exercise metric export and verify the expected values.
